guideTitle: Racing Limits Controls, Overtaking, Nitro, and Upgrade Guide
guideIntro: Fast runs come from reading traffic before committing. Use a camera that exposes the next lane, save nitro for an open section, and make one decisive steering input instead of correcting repeatedly between cars.
steps: Accelerate with the Up arrow, slow with the Down arrow, and steer with the Left and Right arrows.
Choose one-way traffic to learn speed and lane timing, then use two-way traffic when you can read closing gaps earlier.
Press C to test camera views and keep the angle that gives the clearest view of nearby cars and the next overtaking lane.
Use F for nitro only when the road ahead is open enough to benefit from the extra speed, and use E for the horn when traffic awareness matters.
In manual mode, use W to gear up and D to gear down, then spend upgrades on the performance limit that is blocking the next event.
